I have wanted to start playing Warhammer for a while. There was always something stopping me, but now with this new expansion or rule set or what ever its called would this be a good time for someone to get into the game.
Is this Age of Sigmar expansion a good time to get into warhammer.

Depends what you want out of the game.

Do you want engaging battles where regiments battle it out and sound tactical decisions are rewarded? Or would you prefer throwing down a handful of big guys onto a table, rushing them into each other and seeing who can roll the most dice? (While riding imaginary horses and talking to your models)

If you're looking for the former then no, it's not a good time to get into Warhammer. Warhammer Fantasy Battles as we knew it is dead.
Yeah I started looking around at sites and stuff and noticed people are not happy. The 40k people always seem like they think it is a step in the right direction is there any reason why?

There are a few reasons from what I can gather.

The biggest reason (in my opinion) is that AoS is a highly watered down 40k. It's not quite 40k with a Fantasy paint job, but it's much more similar to 40k than WFB ever was. Movement is similar, so is shooting. Thematically, it's similar as well. Golden Spacemarines Paladins fighting for their golden emperor against the foul hordes of chaos. There's also a lower barrier to entry, just a few dudes. There's no longer a need for regiments or blocks of troops - just squads.

As you can tell, I'm quite unhappy about it all. I can imagine that some people can enjoy AoS, but it's really not for me.

I read through the rule books since they are now free to try to get a grasp of what is going on. I can not believe they took out the idea of armies based on a point system. I obviously do not know much about the game but for long time players is that as big of a problem as it seems.

Well, we've gone from an organized system that wasn't always balanced, to green/tan army men.

Right? So before we could agree on a certain size for a battle, and build armies accordingly. You didn't have to build a perfectly balanced army, but there was some order. Rank and File outnumbering Elites and Warmachines, that sort of thing. Now it's really just whatever. Do you want to play with the Nagash twins? Go ahead. Oh, your opponent only has 20 goblins? Don't worry, forge a narrative! Don't get me started on the "Sudden Death" rules that would put the battle even more into Nagash's favor. And with this "pointless" system, why would I ever take rank+file? Elites all the way, right?

There are ways of organizing a wargame without point systems, but "fuck it, bring whatever you want," is not one of them.

Yeah it seems like the only way around that is to set up some kind of veto type system. But there are so many problems with a loose rules veto system it seems like it could just cause more problems for the people playing.

Bingo.

Now imagine that you and your group have worked something out. Cool, right? What happens if you move, or if new players join in?

Yeah I think I will wait a couple months and see how this whole thing plays out. If somehow they manage to make it work, cool but right now it does not seem like a sound investment. Also they are redoing the models by the look of it so its hard to justify buying the old square base models.
